Package org.tasktide.core.model.job_env

Class JobEnvironment

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.core.model.job_env.JobEnvironment
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideModel<JobEnvironment>
@Entity public class JobEnvironment extends Object implements TaskTideModel<JobEnvironment>
Data class to hold collection of host meta-data running job such as where Hostname/Environment etc, job Id, OS, and.

A single JobEnviroment can relate to multiple WorkItem, but a single WorkItem does not relate to multiple JobEnvs.
